blocks.text: Glass calorimeter solutions mein hone wale reactions ki heat napne ke liye munasib hai. Lekin un reactions ke liye kaam nahi aata jin mein gases hon (woh bartan se nikal jayengi), aur na un reactions ke liye jin ke products bohat garam ho jate hain.

Is mein ek beaker, ek stirrer, ek thermometer aur ek dheela (loose-fitting) dhakkan hota hai taa ke andar pressure atmosphere jitna rahe (Figure 6.3). Beaker ki bahar ki deewaron par rui (cotton wool) lagai jati hai taa ke bahar ki hawa se heat ka len den kam se kam ho. Reaction beaker ke andar hota hai, aur nikalne ya jazb hone wali heat temperature ki tabdeeli se napi jati hai. Chunke calorimeter ke andar pressure constant (ek jaisa) rehta hai, is liye temperature napne se reaction ki enthalpy change ΔH nikal aati hai.

blocks.alt: Glass calorimeter: ek chhota beaker bare beaker ke andar rakha hai aur dono ke darmiyan rui (cotton wool) bhari hai. Andar wale beaker mein hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide hai. Muri hui taar ka stirrer aur thermometer chapti lid se guzar kar maye (liquid) mein doobe hain. Labels: Stirrer, Thermometer, Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide, Beakers, Cotton wool.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.3: Reactions ki enthalpy tabdeeli napne ka glass calorimeter (kitab ki Figure 6.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Reaction mein nikalne wali saari heat calorimeter ke andar rehti hai aur pani jazb kar leta hai, is liye:

items: 1000 se taqseem kar ke (divide kar ke) kJ mein badlein.
Reaction ka ΔH is formula se nikalein:

blocks.text_alt: or ΔH = –mcΔT/n kJmol⁻¹ (n = no. of moles)

blocks.text: Yahan istemal hone wale solutions itne patle (dilute) hain ke un ka taqreeban saara mass pani ka hota hai, is liye hum seedhe pani ki specific heat capacity le sakte hain. Aisa calorimeter heat of neutralization (ΔH°n) napne ke liye istemal ho sakta hai, jaisa ke agli misal mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'heat of neutralization' ke baad sirf '(Δ)' chhapa hai; poori alamat ΔH°n hai.

blocks.title: Sample Problem 6.2
blocks.problem: 25 °C par 0.5 mol dm⁻³ NaOH ke 100 cm³ ko 25 °C par 0.5 mol dm⁻³ HCl ke 100 cm³ se neutralize kiya gaya to mixture ka temperature 28.5 °C ho gaya. Enthalpy of neutralization nikalein. Pani ki specific heat = 4.2 J g⁻¹ K⁻¹
steps: Pani ki density taqreeban 1 g cm⁻³ hai, is liye 200 cm³ solution ≈ 200 g.
Kul nikalne wali heat: q = m × c × ΔT = 200 × 4.2 × 3.5 = 2940 J = 2.94 kJ
Moles: mole = concentration (mol/dm³) × volume (dm³); n(HCl) = n(NaOH) = 0.5 × 100/1000 = 0.05 mol
Equation H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O ke mutabiq pani ke moles bhi 0.05 mol bane.
Heat nikli hai, is liye q = –2.94 kJ; ΔH°n = q/n = –2.94 kJ ÷ 0.05 mol

blocks.prompt: 50 cm³ HNO₃ ko 50 cm³ 1.5 mol/dm³ NaOH se react kiya gaya aur temperature 4 °C barha. ΔH°n nikalein (acid ko kam az kam NaOH jitni miqdar mein maan lein).
blocks.explanation: Solution ka mass taqreeban 100 g; q = 100 × 4.2 × 4 = 1680 J = 1.68 kJ. Pani ke moles = NaOH ke moles = 1.5 × 0.050 = 0.075 mol. ΔH°n = –1.68 ÷ 0.075 = –22.4 kJ mol⁻¹. Yeh –57.1 se bohat kam hai; kitab ne HNO₃ ki concentration nahi di aur diye gaye adaad poore strong acid-base neutralization se mel nahi khate.

items: Glass calorimeter: beaker, stirrer, thermometer, dheela dhakkan, rui; solutions ke liye, gases ya bohat garam products ke liye nahi.
ΔH = –q/n = –mcΔT/n; Sample 6.2: q = 2.94 kJ, 0.05 mol pani, ΔH°n = –58.8 kJ mol⁻¹.
